query:
ALTER TABLE `users`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `tosAcceptedAt` timestamp NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `tosVersion` varchar(16) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `disclaimerAcceptedAt` timestamp NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `disclaimerVersion` varchar(16) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `trialEndSent` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `trialNudge5Sent` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `trialNudge6Sent` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `referralCode` varchar(16) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `referredByCode` varchar(16) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `referralCredits` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `creditsEarned` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `graceBriefingUsed` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `isActive` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `suspendedAt` timestamp NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `suspendedReason` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `suspendedBy` int NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `adminNotes` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `lastSignedIn` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now());
